description: Save the project, or a drawing of it, as a file on the user's computer (Downloads unless path says where): ifc (IFC 4, for Revit, Archicad, consultants), glb, gltf, usdz (Apple AR), stl (3D printing), obj (the selection), dxf or svg (a level's plan, or drawing south|north|east|west|section-ew|section-ns; at scale, default 1:100), pdf (every sheet, one a page), xlsx (every schedule, a sheet each) or stori3d (the project file). Returns where it was saved.

drawing.description: dxf/svg: plan (default) or an elevation or section

level.description: dxf/svg plans: level id or name (default the active level)

path.description: Where to save: a folder or a file path (~ allowed). Default: Downloads

name: export_file
title: Export a file
